4hgk8guj81sa4o6coaub55h161.value: Reach the target from the six numbers with + − × and ÷, using each number at most once (not all of them need to be used), and every step a whole number above 0. The program doesn't work out how: it says what an answer is (pick some of the numbers, in some order, split them in two, combine each side, keep it if it hits the target), and the search tries every way. Each of those picks is a Choice, and all collects every answer.
